significance: A Delhi gurdwara marking the meeting of Guru Gobind Singh with Prince Muazzam, later Emperor Bahadur Shah, in 1707. A bungalow of 1664 on the spot was rebuilt as a gurdwara by Sardar Baghel Singh in 1783 and later renovated under Maharaja Ranjit Singh, though most of the standing structure dates from after 1947.
